intent.problem: After #530 merged, check-release-preflight correctly rejects the v0.5.45 freeze because it was generated before the later finalizer and regression changes. The old source tree/archive/digest values are therefore stale against current main. The generated metadata paths are export-ignored, so an evidence-only successor can bind current source bytes without altering those bytes again.
constraints: Use only v0.5.45 and never mutate v0.5.43/v0.5.44.
Do not change release workflow or validators, tags, Releases, assets, or historical archive evidence.
Archive before controlled premerge finalization; retain full governance and require Hosted CI before merge.
Do not claim provider publication during this recovery.
intent.rationale: A fresh independently governed finalization from the current merged source is required. Editing old archives or direct default-branch generation would destroy lifecycle evidence, while the export-ignored projection can survive an evidence-only merge.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized efficiency exception; focused release verification plus full Hosted PR checks remain mandatory.
